data.comment:
# Comfy Eleven v4- Text to Speech

Generate expressive speech from text with Eleven v4, the quality-focused ElevenLabs model. Direct the performance with audio tags such as [whispers] or [excited] written into the script, or upload a voice sample to clone a voice and narrate the script in it. One audio file is output. Ideal for audiobooks, narration, and character voiceovers. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_elevenlabs_v4_text_to_speech.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.text:
[low, gravelly voice, unhurried] The lighthouse was dark for eleven years... until tonight.

[quietly, with wonder] I counted the flashes twice, just to be sure. One. Two. Three.

[sharply, alarmed] Wait... that is NOT the pattern we agreed on.

[whispering, urgent] Kill the lamp. We have to go. NOW.

[dry laugh] ...Or we could stay, and see who is climbing the stairs.
